title: Laylat al-Qadr
def: The Night of Power in Ramadan, “better than a thousand months”, on which the Quran began to be revealed.
what: “We sent it down on the Night of Power. And what will make you know what the Night of Power is? It is better than a thousand months. The angels and the Spirit descend in it by their Lord’s permission, with every command. Peace it is until the rising of dawn” (97:1–5). The Prophet advised searching for it in the odd nights of the last ten days of Ramadan (Sahih al-Bukhari).
